info.title: NEXORA Retail Management & Intelligence System
info.description: Backend API services for demand forecasting, inventory management, and retail intelligence.

get.description: Returns the list and business definitions of forecasting horizons supported by NEXORA.
Returns out-of-time chronological backtesting error metrics (MAE, RMSE, WAPE) across all models.

schema.title: Response Get Model Metrics Api V1 Forecast Model Metrics Get

get.description: Returns active model architectures, feature column specifications, and encoding configuration.

schema.title: Response Get Model Info Api V1 Forecast Model Info Get

post.description: Submits an SKU to generate estimated demand over requested horizons from historical CSV data (or manual features for testing).
Alternative route matching Section 9 of the Technical Blueprint.

get.summary: Get multi-horizon comparative model evaluation metrics
get.description: Returns comparative performance benchmarks across three evaluation tiers: (1) Production Baseline SKU Models, (2) Optimized Experimental SKU Models, and (3) Store-Wide Macro Demand Models, explaining the empirical variance gap.

schema.title: Response Get Evaluation Comparison Api V1 Forecast Evaluation Comparison Get

get.summary: Get store-wide macro aggregate demand forecasts
get.description: Returns multi-horizon store-wide aggregate demand predictions (D_7, D_15, D_30, D_90) and current store-level sales run-rate across all 3,922 catalog SKUs.

schema.title: Response Get Store Wide Forecast Api V1 Forecast Store Wide Get

get.description: Verifies that Task 12 experimental models and the historical dataset are loaded and ready.

schema.title: Response Get Experimental Readiness Api V1 Experimental Ready Get

get.description: Returns the list and candidate model definitions for Task 12 experimental horizons.

schema.title: Response Get Experimental Supported Horizons Api V1 Experimental Forecast Horizons Get

get.summary: Get Task 12 experimental evaluation benchmark metrics
get.description: Returns chronological time-series cross-validation and holdout error metrics for Task 12 models.

schema.title: Response Get Experimental Model Metrics Api V1 Experimental Forecast Model Metrics Get

get.summary: Get Task 12 experimental runtime model architecture
get.description: Returns active Task 12 model architectures, 20-column feature contract, and encoding configuration.

schema.title: Response Get Experimental Model Info Api V1 Experimental Forecast Model Info Get

post.summary: Generate multi-horizon demand forecast using Task 12 experimental models
post.description: Submits an SKU to generate estimated demand over requested horizons using the Task 12 best models.

post.summary: Generate multi-horizon demand forecast (Experimental root alias)
Generate inventory replenishment and purchase recommendation
post.description: Translates machine learning demand forecasts into an explainable purchase recommendation based on current on-hand stock, supplier lead times, review cycles, and safety stock days.

404.description: Product SKU not found in historical catalog

422.description: Validation error or insufficient historical sales data (< 29 days)

503.description: Forecasting service or historical dataset unavailable

get.description:
Service liveness check indicating that the FastAPI process is active.

Returns 200 OK as long as the HTTP process is alive and responsive.
Does not imply that machine learning models or inference datasets are loaded.

Service readiness probe verifying that ML models and historical datasets are ready.

Returns HTTP 200 when all models are verified and dataset is indexed.
Returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable if any component is missing or failed to initialize.

503.description: One or more critical inference subsystems are not ready

ComponentReadiness.title: ComponentReadiness
ComponentReadiness.description: Readiness status for an individual subsystem.

stock_code.title: Stock Code
stock_code.description: Unique product SKU or stock code (e.g. '85123A').

horizons.title: Horizons
horizons.description: List of target horizons in days to forecast (subset of [7, 15, 30, 90]). Defaults to all four.

horizon_days.title: Horizon Days
horizon_days.description: Legacy single horizon field for backward compatibility.

features.description: Historical feature vector. If omitted, flat fields are parsed from root level.

ForecastRequest.title: ForecastRequest
ForecastRequest.description:
Request schema for product demand forecast.

Accepts an SKU identifier, an optional list of requested horizons
(subset of [7, 15, 30, 90]), and historical features (either nested
under 'features' or passed directly as flat fields).

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.description: Key-value mapping of horizon days (e.g. '7', '15', '30', '90') to predicted demand units.

horizon_details.title: Horizon Details
horizon_details.description: Granular performance and model details per requested horizon.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of measurement for forecasted demand

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Informational notes or warnings (e.g., infrequent SKU mapping).

observation_date.title: Observation Date
observation_date.description: Historical observation cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the forecast is projected.

history_days.title: History Days
history_days.description: Number of continuous daily historical records evaluated.

is_auto_generated.title: Is Auto Generated
is_auto_generated.description: True if historical features were automatically derived from CSV dataset.

total_predicted_demand.title: Total Predicted Demand
total_predicted_demand.description: Demand for primary requested horizon (for backward compatibility).

horizon_days.title: Horizon Days
horizon_days.description: Primary horizon in days (for backward compatibility).

ForecastResponse.title: ForecastResponse
ForecastResponse.description: Response schema for multi-horizon demand forecast predictions.

day_of_week.title: Day Of Week
day_of_week.description: Day of week index (0=Monday, 6=Sunday). Defaults to observation date if omitted.

month.title: Month
month.description: Calendar month (1=January, 12=December). Defaults to observation date if omitted.

day_of_month.title: Day Of Month
day_of_month.description: Day of the month (1-31). Defaults to observation date if omitted.

lag_1.title: Lag 1
lag_1.description: Actual sales demand from 1 day prior (t-1). Must be finite and non-negative.

lag_7.title: Lag 7
lag_7.description: Actual sales demand from 7 days prior (t-7). Must be finite and non-negative.

lag_14.title: Lag 14
lag_14.description: Actual sales demand from 14 days prior (t-14). Must be finite and non-negative.

lag_28.title: Lag 28
lag_28.description: Actual sales demand from 28 days prior (t-28). Must be finite and non-negative.

rolling_mean_7.title: Rolling Mean 7
rolling_mean_7.description: Historical 7-day rolling average demand (t-7 to t-1). Must be finite and non-negative.

rolling_mean_28.title: Rolling Mean 28
rolling_mean_28.description: Historical 28-day rolling average demand (t-28 to t-1). Must be finite and non-negative.

lag_60.title: Lag 60
lag_60.description: Actual sales demand from 60 days prior (t-60). Optional.

rolling_mean_14.title: Rolling Mean 14
rolling_mean_14.description: Historical 14-day rolling average demand (t-14 to t-1). Optional.

rolling_mean_60.title: Rolling Mean 60
rolling_mean_60.description: Historical 60-day rolling average demand (t-60 to t-1). Optional.

zero_fraction_28.title: Zero Fraction 28
zero_fraction_28.description: Fraction of zero-demand days over past 28 days (t-28 to t-1). Optional.

momentum_ratio.title: Momentum Ratio
momentum_ratio.description: Ratio of 7-day rolling mean to (28-day rolling mean + 1). Optional.

has_60d_history.title: Has 60D History
has_60d_history.description: Coverage indicator (1.0 if history >= 60 days, else 0.0). Optional.

HistoricalFeatures.title: HistoricalFeatures
HistoricalFeatures.description: Historical demand lag and rolling statistics for feature input.

predicted_demand.title: Predicted Demand
predicted_demand.description: Projected cumulative demand units over horizon

HorizonPredictionDetail.title: HorizonPredictionDetail
HorizonPredictionDetail.description: Detailed breakdown for a single forecast horizon.

stock_code.title: Stock Code
stock_code.description: Unique product SKU or stock code (e.g. '85123A').

current_stock.title: Current Stock
current_stock.description: Current physical or available on-hand stock quantity. Must be non-negative.

lead_time_days.title: Lead Time Days
lead_time_days.description: Supplier replenishment lead time in calendar days (default: 7).

review_period_days.title: Review Period Days
review_period_days.description: Inventory review and reorder cycle period in calendar days (default: 7).

safety_stock_days.title: Safety Stock Days
safety_stock_days.description: Safety buffer expressed in days of projected daily demand (default: 3.0).

use_experimental.title: Use Experimental
use_experimental.description: Whether to use Task 12 experimental models instead of baseline production models.

InventoryRecommendationRequest.title: InventoryRecommendationRequest
InventoryRecommendationRequest.description: Request schema for inventory replenishment recommendation.

lead_time_days.title: Lead Time Days
lead_time_days.description: Supplier replenishment lead time in days

coverage_period_days.title: Coverage Period Days
coverage_period_days.description: Total coverage cycle window in days (lead_time + review_period)

forecast_demand.title: Forecast Demand
forecast_demand.description: Projected cumulative customer demand over coverage period

daily_demand_rate.title: Daily Demand Rate
daily_demand_rate.description: Average daily projected demand rate (forecast_demand / coverage_period_days)

recommended_purchase_quantity.title: Recommended Purchase Quantity
recommended_purchase_quantity.description: Recommended additional stock units to purchase (max(0, target_stock - current_stock))

calculation_explanation.title: Calculation Explanation
calculation_explanation.description: Transparent mathematical breakdown of the recommendation calculation

model_used.title: Model Used
model_used.description: ML model pipeline version utilized for demand inference

InventoryRecommendationResponse.title: InventoryRecommendationResponse
InventoryRecommendationResponse.description: Response schema for inventory replenishment recommendation.

ReadinessResponse.title: ReadinessResponse
ReadinessResponse.description: Overall readiness response schema for health and lifecycle probes.

supported_horizons_days.title: Supported Horizons Days
supported_horizons_days.description: List of integer horizon windows in days

SupportedHorizonsResponse.title: SupportedHorizonsResponse
SupportedHorizonsResponse.description: Response schema for supported forecast horizons.
